newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Top Italy coffee roaster sees new product success.
newsitem.headline: Top Italy coffee roaster sees new product success.

text.p: A leading Italy's top coffee roaster, Caffe Corsini, on Tuesday said it had experienced success with a newly-developed espresso product.

"There's ... been a great interest for high-quality coffee pod, that's something Italian roasters are trying to develop and we think it will very soon become popular," said company president Silvano Corsini.
Pod is a coffee product similar to a tea-bag developed for espresso machines, which first was introduced to the Italian market about one year ago by Italy's Illycaffe company.

Silvano Corsino said his company had introduced its own pod-product six months ago and already was selling more than 10,000 7-gramme pods a day. He expected sales to double "at least five times" before the end of the year.
"We have been developing this product for two years now and the quality is equivalent to the traditionally-brewed espresso, but it's very, very easy to operate," said Corsine.
Corsini was speaking to Reuters on the opening day of a three-day Tea and Coffee Symposium conference.
